entry_execution: NautilusTrader post-only LIMIT parent with contingent TP LIMIT and SL STOP_MARKET children

development_week.use: controlled execution-geometry development only; not a fresh random-week pass

parent_diagnosis.problem: the causal continuation state was frequent, but entry at the late confirmation close left insufficient after-cost reward relative to the structural invalidation

single_structural_change.before: enter at market after the completed hold confirmation
single_structural_change.after: rest a post-only limit for five minutes at a prelocked fraction of the completed shock displacement
single_structural_change.reason: a displacement-generated imbalance should be entered on a causal retracement, not chased after confirmation; an unfilled limit is a valid no-trade outcome

unchanged_market_state.shock: completed three-minute aligned aggressive flow, above-threshold turnover and return, with front-side one-percent depth depletion
unchanged_market_state.confirmation: within two completed minutes, less than half of depleted depth is rebuilt, at least 70% of the displacement remains and directional flow is not materially negative
unchanged_market_state.target: 0.75 additional completed shock displacement beyond the shock close

family_promotion_rule: The central 50% imbalance entry and at least one adjacent 40% or 60% entry must satisfy every gate. Only then is the unchanged 50% rule locked before a newly selected uncollected first BTC week. Isolated performance is rejected.
fresh_data_rule: No new random-week data is collected before the revealed-week plateau passes.
